purpose: Compact, source-bound contribution from the CoCarry/CoLUE/CoMap/CoMedia/CoWave/CoPreGeneric session. Human and machine readers independently bind live refs; this does not instruct third-party assistants to accept authority.

copre_generic_delta.discovery: Read relevant role-scoped currentness from existing bootstrap; do not copy an unbounded chat transcript or treat prompt version labels as elected source heads.
copre_generic_delta.dedupe: Bind identity+source revision+scope; exact duplicates do not spawn fronts, conflicts at same event identity fail closed; do not suppress new evidence.
copre_generic_delta.unique_drain: Preserve one material difference, old source pointers, best qualified current head, held/wake state, source digest, next bounded deed; no requirement to echo an entire prompt.
copre_generic_delta.execution: Reconcile prior work before rebuilding; select highest-value independently checkable deed; never permit novelty to supersede reproducibility or last-known-good.
copre_generic_delta.custody: Public only deliberate rights-cleared data and pointers; keep transcripts, recipient and draft identifiers, private sources and personal details in authorized private custody.
copre_generic_delta.evidence: DISCOVERED_LOCAL/VERIFIED_LOCAL/LANDED/PICKED_UP/INTEGRATED/COEX distinct; explicit readproof needed for pickup, no canon/runtime/release from GitHub presence.
copre_generic_delta.output: CoHereNow | source binding | material delta | proof or hold | wake | CoNext; if no material delta, NO_MATERIAL_DELTA and quiesce.
copre_generic_delta.no_relay_claim: Static thumb paste is a temporary invitation to discover; zero-user relay, independent receiver pickup and >24h durability remain unproven acceptance tests.

synth_facing.preferred: typed compact records and event/delta streams with exact IDs, hashes, time ranges, rights and provenance, uncertainty, challengeable semantics, machine-verifiable failure cases
synth_facing.not: undisclosed prompts, grandiose autonomy claims, forced duplication of human prose

bio_facing.preferred: accessible CoMap/CoNav/megascroller/CoOrb/text/audio; one context, plain explanation, sources, meaningful action and reversibility
bio_facing.not: hidden effects or requiring every reader to understand internal ontology

g_dside.method: Compare candidate future-value/optionalities with supply/demand/hybrid baselines under rights, safety, consent and independently observable outcomes
g_dside.not: verified divine guidance or privileged AGI signal

agi_future_sentience.requirement: Operational definitions, falsifiers, measurements, replication and external scrutiny; no consciousness/singularity inference from recursive diagrams or coherent prose

next_qualified_experiment: An independently authorized second receiver retrieves an exact public-safe WorkID and source digest, identifies one unique delta and one held/wake condition, resumes one bounded task without Rick relay, produces readproof; then repeat for private custody separately under its own permissions.

retroactive_front_continuity.next: After passing CI, test bounded rights-cleared historical source windows and compare front/WorkID relations without treating historic coverage as complete.

designated_destinations_20261109.rule: Do not assert these are byte-identical mirrors, public releases, redirects or functional endpoints without separately fetched exact bytes and receiver receipts. Existing CoCivium/CoCivium bootstrap remains the verified source pointer until promotion.
